problem: If $\,\text{Re}(x)=[\begin{aligned}a & b \\ c & d\end{aligned}]\,$ and $\,\text{Im}(x)=[\begin{aligned}e & f \\ g & h\end{aligned}]\,$ are the real and imaginary parts of the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}-3\text{i} & 5\text{i} \\ -4 & 5\end{aligned}]\,$ then what is the value of $ah-cf?$

feedback.problem: Find the imaginary part of the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}1-7\text{i} & 2-4\text{i} \\ 6\text{i} & -5\end{aligned}].$
feedback.worked_solution:
For the given matrix $A,$ we have that

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}1-7\text{i} & 2-4\text{i} \\ 6\text{i} & -5\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1-7\text{i} & 2-4\text{i} \\ 0+6\text{i} & -5+0\text{i}\end{aligned}] \\  & ={{[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 0 & -5\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{\text{Re}(A)}+\text{i}{{[\begin{aligned}-7 & -4 \\ 6 & 0\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{\text{Im}(A)}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $\text{Im}(A)=[\begin{aligned}-7 & -4 \\ 6 & 0\end{aligned}].$
